title: How to build a fearless organisation? - CEO Circle with Amy Edmondson and Paul Verdin

getting better the job of the board is to treat strategy as as a learning journey to treat strategy as a hypothesis that must continually be tested if you're testing a hypothesis means you're a scientist and if you're a scientist you need a sense of psychological safety to offer observations to offer ideas to say we might be missing something we might be off base be prepared to falsify in
